BiblicalUsage: Hazezon-tamar, the place of palm trees, is named twice and both times war comes to it. The kings smite the Amorites there in Abram's day, and a great multitude gathers there against Jehoshaphat, the same place called En-gedi.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a place of palms can be a place of battle, and God defends His people in both. Hazezon-tamar saw Abram rescue Lot and Jehoshaphat pray, and the victories belong to the same God.
RelatedEvents: Abram Rescues Lot; Jehoshaphat's Victory by Prayer and Praise
